name: managing-debt-covenant-compliance
description: Manages ongoing debt covenant compliance after a financing closes: leverage and coverage covenant calculations under the credit agreement's own Consolidated EBITDA definition; Test Period, step-down and springing revolver tests; draft compliance certificates; a deadline calendar giving financial statements, certificates, equity cure windows and grace periods each their own trigger; equity cure limits; Default versus Event of Default; waivers and amendments with Required Lenders and affected-lender vote counts; basket and builder basket tracking; open market purchase and liability management flags after Serta; and ASC 470-10 and IAS 1 debt classification inputs. Use for ongoing covenant calculations and compliance certificates after close, headroom on actual or after-close figures, credit agreement Consolidated EBITDA add-backs and caps, equity cure, covenant waiver or amendment, or debt classification after a breach. Declines to adjust reported figures to manufacture compliance; drafts only.
